purpose: Remove retained Unity built-in primitive renderer meshes from benchmark-facing structural fallback components while preserving physical dimensions, construction logic and gameplay collision footprint.

visualFidelityRelationship.rule: Source-side replacement reduces primitive shading and razor-edge risk only. The critical defect may be cleared only from the sealed native-4K hero/oblique/grazing evidence and 100% crops.

reinforcedConcreteMasses.construction: cast/precast reinforced-concrete structural masses and balcony/parapet interfaces
reinforcedConcreteMasses.edgeConstruction: formed arrises receive a small real geometric edge break; maximum source-side bevel 6 mm, never a broad stylized roundover
reinforcedConcreteMasses.mountingAndInterfaces: dimensions and world bounds are inherited exactly from the established benchmark assembly; no repositioning is allowed
reinforcedConcreteMasses.exposureAndAging: existing rain/UV/splash/recess metadata and material contracts remain authoritative; this pass changes geometry only

paintedSteelRails.edgeConstruction: 2 mm maximum geometric edge break to avoid razor-edge specular response without turning square stock into tubing
paintedSteelRails.mountingAndInterfaces: existing high-detail base plates, bolts and wall interfaces remain unchanged

equipmentAndDrainage.construction: aged outdoor-unit casing plus attached vertical drainage/downpipe hardware
equipmentAndDrainage.edgeConstruction: AC casing maximum 4 mm edge radius proxy; cylindrical downpipe uses a dimension-baked beveled circular mesh
equipmentAndDrainage.mountingAndInterfaces: existing feet, pipe pairs, collars, drain hose and downpipe stand-off clamps remain authoritative

groundLayers.construction: coarse gameplay-support ground layers retained beneath high-detail paving/joints/curbs/drainage
groundLayers.edgeConstruction: maximum 3 mm edge break; high-detail interfaces, not the base slab edge, carry construction readability
groundLayers.collisionRole: coarse gameplay collision must remain unchanged while visual mesh scale is baked

materialResponsibility.rule: This contract does not create or alter albedo, metallic/specular, roughness, normal, microstructure, wetness, UV aging or Fresnel response. Existing material/construction contracts remain authoritative.

geometryVsMaterialDetail.geometry: physical edge break, silhouette, retained structural dimensions
geometryVsMaterialDetail.material: surface color, PBR response, normal-scale microstructure and cause-based weathering

legacyRegressionRules.LampGlobe: The old built-in Sphere must not be actively rendered; the physical period lamp diffuser replacement must control the benchmark.

lodAndTemporal.rule: Renderer references and LODGroup membership are preserved because only sharedMesh and scale/collider dimensions are changed. Real native-4K temporal probes remain mandatory for shimmer/LOD-pop assessment.
